items.sourceText: When does the bus to Sofia leave?
items.hint: A question about departure time and direction.

items.sourceText: The bus to Sofia leaves now.
items.hint: This shows the direction of the bus.

items.sourceText: The train from Varna arrives today.
items.hint: This shows the starting point.

items.sourceText: The metro stops in the centre.
items.hint: “In” is used with the centre.

items.sourceText: The taxi arrives at the station.
items.hint: “At” is used with the station.

items.sourceText: A ticket to Burgas.
items.hint: On a ticket, this shows the destination.

items.sourceText: The bus station is in the centre.
items.hint: “In” is used with the centre.

items.sourceText: The stop is in front of the station.
items.hint: This shows a position in front of a place.

items.sourceText: Where is the tram stop?
items.hint: A question about a specific stop.

items.sourceText: Where does the bus leave from?
items.hint: This asks where something leaves from.

items.sourceText: Where does the bus leave from?
items.hint: This asks about the starting point.

items.sourceText: When is the first bus to Plovdiv?
items.hint: A question about the first service.

items.sourceText: When is the last bus to Plovdiv?
items.hint: A question about the last service.

items.sourceText: When is the next bus to Plovdiv?
items.hint: A question about the next service.

items.sourceText: The first bus is at seven o'clock.
items.hint: An answer about the first service.

items.sourceText: I am travelling by bus.
items.hint: A phrase about the means of transport.

items.sourceText: I am travelling by train.
items.hint: A phrase about the means of transport.

items.sourceText: Does this bus go to the centre?
items.hint: A question about the direction of transport.

items.sourceText: Does this train go to Sofia?
items.hint: A question about the route of the train.

items.sourceText: I want one ticket to Sofia.
items.hint: A request to buy a ticket.

items.sourceText: The plane leaves for Germany.
items.hint: This shows direction.

items.sourceText: The ticket office is at the station.
items.hint: “At” is used with the station.

items.sourceText: The train stops at the first platform.
items.hint: “At” is used with the platform.

items.sourceText: I am going to the airport.
items.hint: “At” is used with the airport.

items.sourceText: The suitcase is on the bus.
items.hint: This shows being inside the bus.

items.sourceText: I am buying a metro card.
items.hint: This shows the purpose of the card.

items.sourceText: Does this bus stop in the centre?
items.hint: A question about the stop location.

items.sourceText: Does this train arrive in Sofia?
items.hint: A question about the arrival city.

items.sourceText: Does the metro stop at this stop?
items.hint: A question about a stop.

items.sourceText: I am flying by plane.
items.hint: A phrase about travelling.

items.sourceText: I am travelling by train.
items.hint: A phrase about travelling.

items.sourceText: I am travelling by tram.
items.hint: A phrase about travelling.

items.sourceText: I am travelling by taxi.
items.hint: A phrase about travelling.

items.sourceText: I am travelling by metro.
items.hint: A phrase about travelling.

items.sourceText: How many tickets do you want?
items.hint: A question about the number of tickets.

items.sourceText: I want two tickets to Sofia.
items.hint: An answer about quantity and direction.

items.sourceText: How many minutes late is the train?
items.hint: A question about the train delay.

items.sourceText: The train is ten minutes late.
items.hint: This shows the amount of delay.

items.sourceText: How much does the ticket cost?
items.hint: A question about the price of one ticket.

items.sourceText: How many leva does the ticket cost?
items.hint: A question about the price in leva.

items.sourceText: The ticket costs ten leva.
items.hint: An answer about the ticket price.

items.sourceText: How do you get to the Central Station?
items.hint: This asks about the way of travelling.

items.sourceText: I go by bus to the Central Station.
items.hint: “By” marks transport, “to” marks the end point.

items.sourceText: Which track does the train arrive at?
items.hint: A question about the arrival track.

items.sourceText: Which sector does the bus arrive at?
items.hint: A question about the arrival sector.

items.sourceText: Which track does the train leave from?
items.hint: This asks about the departure track.

items.sourceText: Which sector does the bus leave from?
items.hint: This asks about the departure sector.

items.sourceText: Do you have a ticket?
items.hint: A question about a ticket.

items.sourceText: Yes, I have a card.
items.hint: An answer about a ticket.

items.sourceText: No, I do not have a card.
items.hint: A negative answer.

items.sourceText: The bus leaves from the bus station.
items.hint: This shows the place of departure.

items.sourceText: The bus leaves for Sliven.
items.hint: This shows direction.

items.sourceText: The train leaves from the station.
items.hint: This shows the place of departure.

items.sourceText: The train leaves for Varna.
items.hint: This shows direction.

items.sourceText: The bus leaves at eight o'clock.
items.hint: “At” is used with exact time.

items.sourceText: When does the bus leave?
items.hint: A question about departure time.

items.sourceText: Which bus station does the bus leave from?
items.hint: This asks where from.

items.sourceText: Which city does the bus leave for?
items.hint: This asks about the destination city.

items.sourceText: The bus leaves from Sofia.
items.hint: Leaves from: from where.

items.sourceText: The bus leaves for Burgas.
items.hint: Leaves for: to where.

items.sourceText: The train leaves from Plovdiv.
items.hint: This marks the starting point.

items.sourceText: The train leaves for Varna.
items.hint: This marks direction.

items.sourceText: When does the train leave?
items.hint: A question about departure time.

items.sourceText: Which city does the train leave from?
Which city does the bus leave for?
items.hint: This asks which city something goes to.

items.sourceText: The bus stops in the centre.
items.hint: “In” is used with the centre or a city.

items.sourceText: The bus stops at the bus station.
items.hint: “At” is used with the bus station.

items.sourceText: The train stops at the station.
items.hint: “At” is used with the station.

items.sourceText: The tram stops in the centre.
items.hint: “In” is used with the centre.

items.sourceText: The metro stops at this stop.
items.hint: “At” is used with the stop.

items.sourceText: Where does the bus stop?
items.hint: A question about the stop location.

items.sourceText: The bus does not stop here.
items.hint: Negation with the verb “stop”.

items.sourceText: The bus arrives in Plovdiv.
items.hint: “In” is used with a city.

items.sourceText: The bus arrives at the bus station.
items.hint: “At” is used with the bus station.

items.sourceText: The train arrives in Sofia.
items.hint: “In” is used with a city.

items.sourceText: The train arrives at the station.
items.hint: “At” is used with the station.

items.sourceText: The plane arrives in Bulgaria.
items.hint: “In” is used with a country.

items.sourceText: The plane arrives at the airport.
items.hint: “At” is used with the airport.

items.sourceText: When does the train arrive?
items.hint: A question about arrival time.

items.sourceText: Where does the bus arrive?
items.hint: A question about the place of arrival.

items.sourceText: I am going to Germany.
items.hint: This shows the direction of travel.

items.sourceText: I am going to Sofia.
items.hint: This shows the direction of travel.

items.sourceText: I am going to Varna by bus.
items.hint: “By” marks transport, “to” marks direction.

items.sourceText: I am going to Burgas by train.
items.hint: “By” marks transport, “to” marks direction.

items.sourceText: I am flying to Germany by plane.
items.hint: “By” marks transport, “to” marks direction.

items.sourceText: How are you travelling?
items.hint: This asks about the means of transport.

items.sourceText: Where are you going?
items.hint: This asks about direction.

items.sourceText: I am going from Sofia to Varna.
items.hint: “From” marks the starting point, “to” marks direction.

items.sourceText: I am going from Plovdiv to Burgas.
items.hint: “From” marks the starting point, “to” marks direction.

items.sourceText: Mustafa returns from Vratsa.
items.hint: Returns from: from where.

items.sourceText: Mustafa returns to Syria.
items.hint: Returns to: to where.

items.sourceText: I return from Sofia.
items.hint: This shows where someone returns from.

items.sourceText: I return to Bulgaria.
items.hint: This shows where someone returns to.

items.sourceText: She returns from the station.
items.hint: This shows the starting point.

items.sourceText: She returns to the centre.
Where are you returning from?
items.hint: This asks about the starting point.

items.sourceText: Where are you returning to?
items.hint: This asks about the destination place.

items.sourceText: The bus comes from Varna.
items.hint: This shows where something comes from.

items.sourceText: Does the bus come from Sofia?
items.hint: A question about the starting point.

items.sourceText: Does this bus go to Sofia?
items.hint: A question about the route direction.
